tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies flat on its back on a wooden dock, both arms stretched overhead toward the camera, palms turned outward and fingers spread wide against the sky, while its legs dangle over the water's edge.
tasks.camera: low-angle close-up from above the head, looking down at the upturned palms
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms face the camera fully open with all five fingers extended and unobstructed.
tasks.intent_zh: 仰躺码头，双手举向镜头摊开手掌

tasks.instruction: Balancing on a narrow stone wall, the blue tiger crouches and presses both palms flat against the top of the wall for support, fingers splayed, while gazing down at a garden below.
tasks.camera: side high-angle medium shot showing both hands planted on the wall
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands rest palm-down on the wall, every finger clearly separated and visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在窄墙上双手撑地俯瞰花园

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels beside a shallow tide pool and cups both hands together underwater to scoop up a small crab, palms facing upward with fingers gently curled and clearly seen through the clear water.
tasks.camera: close overhead shot into the tide pool, framed on the cupped hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both cupped palms and all ten fingers are visible through the water, unobstructed by the crab.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在潮池边双手捧水捉蟹

tasks.instruction: Hanging upside down from a thick tree branch, the blue tiger grips the bark with both hands, arms straight, palms wrapped around the branch with fingers dug in, tail curling below.
tasks.camera: low-angle shot from beneath the branch, hands and branch silhouetted against the canopy
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands grip the front of the branch so palms and all five fingers per hand are visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 倒挂树枝，双手抓握树皮

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans out of a hot-air balloon basket and holds both palms out flat to feel the wind, fingers spread as the landscape blurs far below.
tasks.camera: frontal medium shot from inside the basket, hands toward lens
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both open palms face the camera with all fingers extended and fully clear of the basket rim.
tasks.intent_zh: 探出热气球篮，双手摊开迎风

tasks.instruction: Seated cross-legged on a woven rug, the blue tiger holds a hand mirror up with one hand while pressing the other palm flat against its cheek, fingers spread, examining its reflection.
tasks.camera: frontal close-up at face height, both hands in frame beside the face
tasks.visibility_requirement: The palm against the cheek and the mirror-holding hand are both fully visible with all fingers distinct.
tasks.intent_zh: 盘坐持镜，一手贴脸端详

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crawls forward through a low tunnel on hands and knees, both palms pressed flat on the sandy floor in mid-stride, fingers spread for grip, head lowered to fit.
tasks.camera: rear three-quarter low shot looking through the tunnel at the planted hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both crawling palms are flat on the ground ahead of the body with every finger visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 在低矮隧道内四肢爬行

tasks.instruction: At a potter's wheel, the blue tiger leans over and shapes a clay bowl with both palms curved around the spinning form, fingers gently pressing the wet clay, sleeves rolled up.
tasks.camera: side close-up over the wheel, both hands centered on the clay
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both clay-covered palms and all ten fingers are visible around the bowl.
tasks.intent_zh: 陶轮前双手塑形泥碗

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on its stomach on a grassy hill, propped on both elbows, palms flat on the ground ahead with fingers spread, chin lifted, watching clouds drift past.
tasks.camera: front low-angle shot at ground level, palms prominent in the foreground
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both forearms rest on the grass with palms flat and all fingers clearly splayed.
tasks.intent_zh: 趴在草坡上双肘撑地看云

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger juggles three glowing orbs, both palms facing upward mid-toss with fingers wide and alert, eyes tracking the highest orb.
tasks.camera: frontal medium shot, hands at chest height with orbs above
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both upturned palms and all fingers are visible, unobstructed by the floating orbs.
tasks.intent_zh: 双手抛接三颗发光球

tasks.instruction: Pressing both palms against a tall pane of frosted glass, the blue tiger peers through from the far side, fingers spread wide, breath fogging the surface around its hands.
tasks.camera: frontal shot from behind the glass, hands and face framed by fog
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms are flattened on the glass facing the viewer, every finger clearly outlined.
tasks.intent_zh: 双手按在磨砂玻璃上向内张望

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a swing seat and grips both chains high above its head, palms wrapped around the links with fingers visible, legs swinging forward.
tasks.camera: low-angle frontal shot from the ground, chains and hands overhead
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands grip the front of the chains with palms and all fingers visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在秋千上双手高举握链

tasks.instruction: Leaning over a balcony railing at night, the blue tiger rests both palms on the rail and gazes at city lights, fingers lightly drumming the metal.
tasks.camera: side medium shot along the railing, hands on the top bar
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms rest on top of the railing with all five fingers per hand visible against the lights.
tasks.intent_zh: 倚靠阳台栏杆，双手搭在栏杆上

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels to plant a small sapling, pressing soil around the roots with both palms, fingers sinking into the dark earth, a trowel set aside.
tasks.camera: high-angle close shot looking down at the hands and sapling
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands are pressed into the soil with palms and all fingers clearly visible around the stem.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪地双手培土种下树苗

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger floats on its back in a calm lake, arms spread wide at the surface, palms upturned and fingers relaxed, ripples spreading from each hand.
tasks.camera: overhead top-down shot at water level, arms and palms extended
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both upturned palms break the water surface fully with all fingers visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 仰浮湖面，双臂摊开手掌朝上

tasks.instruction: Clinging to the side of a climbing wall, the blue tiger reaches one palm up to a high hold while the other palm presses flat against a lower grip, fingers spread on both.
tasks.camera: side medium shot from the wall, both hands on colored holds
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms are pressed flat against the holds with all five fingers visible per hand.
tasks.intent_zh: 攀岩墙上双手抓握不同岩点

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches at a stream and slaps both palms down onto the water surface to splash, fingers splayed wide, droplets frozen mid-air around the hands.
tasks.camera: front low-angle close shot at water level, palms flat toward the surface
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both flat palms are visible in the splash with all fingers distinct and clear of droplets.
tasks.intent_zh: 溪边俯身双手拍水溅起水花

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a low stool, the blue tiger stretches both arms forward and interlaces its fingers, palms facing outward in a deep stretch, eyes closed with a calm expression.
tasks.camera: frontal medium close-up, interlaced hands centered
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands are interlaced and turned palm-out; all ten fingers visible from the front.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐姿双手交叉前伸拉伸

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger carefully stacks smooth river stones into a cairn, both palms cupping the top stone to balance it, fingers steadying the edges.
tasks.camera: side close-up at cairn height, both hands around the top stone
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands cup the stone with palms and all fingers clearly visible on its sides.
tasks.intent_zh: 双手码放溪石堆叠成塔

tasks.instruction: Hanging by both hands from a horizontal bar, the blue tiger tucks its knees and holds a mid-air tuck, palms wrapped over the bar with fingers hooked forward.
tasks.camera: side medium shot, bar across the top, hands gripping
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands hook over the front of the bar with all fingers and palms visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 单杠上双手悬挂收膝团身

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels over a large map spread on the floor, both palms pressed flat on the paper to smooth it, fingers spread across continents.
tasks.camera: overhead top-down shot of the map, hands spread wide
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms lie flat on the map facing up toward the camera, all fingers clearly spread.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在地图上双手压平纸张

tasks.instruction: Wading through waist-deep snow, the blue tiger pushes both palms forward to part a drift, fingers spread and dusted with flakes, leaning into the effort.
tasks.camera: frontal medium shot, palms pushing toward the lens through snow
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both forward-facing palms and all fingers are visible above the snow surface.
tasks.intent_zh: 齐腰深雪中双手推开雪堆前行

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits at a low table and claps both palms together in a sharp beat, fingers aligned, mid-clap with a focused expression at a drum circle.
tasks.camera: frontal close-up at table height, hands meeting in the center
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms face each other mid-clap with all fingers of both hands visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 矮桌旁双手击掌打节拍

tasks.instruction: Reaching up into a dense berry bush, the blue tiger parts the branches with both palms, fingers spread among the leaves, searching for ripe fruit.
tasks.camera: frontal close shot inside the bush, hands pushing leaves aside
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms push branches apart with all fingers visible among the leaves.
tasks.intent_zh: 灌木丛中双手拨开枝条找浆果

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on its side on a sandy beach and props its head on one palm while the other palm rests flat on the sand, fingers spread, watching the surf.
tasks.camera: side low-angle shot along the sand, both hands near the face
tasks.visibility_requirement: The propping palm under the chin and the flat palm on the sand are both fully visible with all fingers.
tasks.intent_zh: 侧卧沙滩，一手托腮一手按沙

tasks.instruction: Kneeling in front of a large drum, the blue tiger raises both palms overhead and brings them down in a powerful strike, fingers flat and together mid-swing.
tasks.camera: front low-angle shot, palms raised above the drum
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both raised palms face the drum with all fingers extended and clearly visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在大鼓前双手高举击鼓

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger squeezes through a narrow rock crevice, both palms flat against the rock walls on either side, fingers spread for leverage, body sideways.
tasks.camera: frontal medium shot down the crevice, hands braced on both walls
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms are pressed flat on the facing rock walls with all fingers visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 侧身挤过岩缝，双手撑住两侧岩壁

tasks.instruction: Holding a large seashell to its ear with one palm cupped around it, the blue tiger presses the other palm flat over its other ear, fingers spread, listening intently.
tasks.camera: frontal close-up at head height, both hands framing the face
tasks.visibility_requirement: The shell-cupping palm and the palm over the ear are both fully visible with all fingers.
tasks.intent_zh: 一手捧贝壳贴耳，一手捂耳倾听

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches low and reaches both palms into a glowing campfire to warm them, fingers spread toward the flames, face lit orange from below.
tasks.camera: front low-angle medium shot, palms toward the fire and lens
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms face the flames and camera with all fingers clearly spread and unobstructed.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在篝火旁双手伸向火焰取暖

tasks.instruction: Standing on a paddleboard, the blue tiger holds a long paddle across its body with both palms gripping the shaft, fingers wrapped, knees slightly bent for balance.
tasks.camera: side medium shot at water level, both hands on the paddle shaft
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands grip the paddle shaft with palms and all five fingers visible per hand.
tasks.intent_zh: 站立桨板上双手握桨保持平衡
